findings.text: The company has the status 'active' and was incorporated on 26 February 2013.
There are no current directors recorded, with the officer list comprising two other officers.
One individual, PERSON 348, is listed as a person with significant control, holding voting rights and asset sharing rights of 75 to 100 percent.
Accounts are not overdue, with the last accounts made up to 31 March 2025 and the next due on 31 December 2026.
The confirmation statement is not overdue, with the last statement made up to 1 March 2026 and the next due on 15 March 2027.
No insolvency record is held for the company.
No charges are registered against the company.
No registered office address changes or officer appointments and resignations have been filed since 24 October 2025.

headline.text: TEST COMPANY 461 is an active limited liability partnership incorporated in 2013 with no current directors, no insolvency records, and up-to-date statutory filings.
